title: Evidence Provenance vs Enterprise Applicability Separation
objective: Keep canonical Evidence subject and publisher stable while resolving Enterprise applicability separately.
implementation_summary: Flora now distinguishes what an Evidence object is about from the Enterprises to which that Evidence is relevant. Shared, regulatory and competitive Evidence remains available where applicable, but another company's Evidence can no longer become the dossier Enterprise's own company financial reporting.
expected_visible_outcomes: EV-CF-2025 retains CityFibre as its subject in BT and CityFibre contexts and is ineligible as BT company reporting.
EV-BT-Q1FY27 remains BT-subject Evidence eligible for BT company reporting.
Key Reports exposes the best governed report, evidence extract or evidence link without inventing a report or URL.
External analyst / market research remains truthfully absent where no qualifying report is supplied.
unchanged_areas: Protected: 308 Relationship candidates; working Enterprise identity lineage and associations; 13 Programmes; 17 Opportunities; factual dimension isolation; candidate governance.
required_test_steps: Inspect EV-CF-2025 and confirm subject CityFibre, separately explained BT applicability, and no BT company-report eligibility.
Inspect EV-BT-Q1FY27 and confirm subject BT Group and BT company-report eligibility.
Confirm the best available governed report, evidence extract or evidence link is shown.
Confirm no report or URL has been invented.
Confirm external analyst / market research remains truthfully absent.
fresh_import_policy: NO — runtime association and selection use unchanged canonical imported objects.
known_limitations: TEL-001 supplies no qualifying BT external analyst, broker, equity-research or market-research report; the runtime therefore shows a truthful empty state.
Evidence availability does not promote unextracted report content into canonical Enterprise facts.
Enterprise Economics and Leadership / Governance remain architectural intent, not independently implemented TEL-001 runtime dimensions.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in the focused evidence-utilisation, Executive Enterprise Intelligence and TEL-001 regression suites.

operator_validation_status: PASS — six Enterprise dossier routes rendered from canonical facts and associations
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
material_runtime_components_changed: Enterprise dossier Key Reports evidence projection
